failure.primary: routed-expert boundary is only valid on a returning root
failure.terminal_finalization_error: captured policy-call count differs from the Verifiers trace
failure.diagnosis: A natural child used IPython and returned for a second policy turn. The pinned renderer legitimately emitted routed_experts_prompt_start on that depth-1 continuation, but the live observer allowed the boundary only on a returning depth-0 root. The observer rejected the same child continuation 30 times before model execution. Verifiers retained those failed call attempts while the receipt ledger captured only the four successful policy generations, so source finalization correctly rejected the 34-versus-4 count mismatch. The count mismatch is downstream fallout; the unsupported multi-turn-child observer topology is the root cause.
failure.preflight_gap: The frozen tests exercised a returning root and first-turn children, but not a real two-turn child continuation through the patched renderer, interception client, and observer. The observer classifier would also reject a child session_call_ordinal above zero.

scientific_status.valid_engineering_observation: The shared scaffold elicited two natural child calls and a returning root, but a child can self-tool and create a continuation that the observer cannot durably classify as topology-ineligible.

disposition: V8 is terminal under its frozen final-successor rule. Do not launch v9 or scientific training. A future live successor would require an explicit user decision to supersede that hard stop, a corrected child-continuation boundary contract, and a full-stack two-turn child regression before a new preregistration.
